M'sieur: syncopic form of Monsieur, chiefly used by children
M. et Mme: Mr. and Mrs. (a title used for a married couple before the surname or before the name of the husband)
夫妇 （用于已婚夫妻姓氏或丈夫名字之前的称号）
Mʳ: alternative spelling of Mʳ: abbreviation of monsieur
Mʳˢ: alternative spelling of Mʳˢ: plural of Mʳ
Mᵐᵉ: alternative spelling of Mᵐᵉ: abbreviation of madame
Mᵐᵉˢ: alternative spelling of Mᵐᵉˢ: plural of Mᵐᵉ
m'a: me + a (third-person singular indicative present form of avoir)
m'as: Equivalent to "je vais" when used as a near-future tense.
m'as-tu-vu: a show-off, an attention-seeker, a fop
